Callout.Name: Warehouse Fire
Callout.Message: Fire in a storage warehouse, unknown contents.
Callout.Advisory: Staff evacuated, pallets and chemicals inside.

Script.Line: We do not know what is in there. It is pallet racking, all of it.
The last delivery was aerosols. That is all I can tell you.
The shutter is shut and it is hot to the touch. Do not open the shutter.

Lines.Approach: Nobody knows what is on those pallets, which is the part that matters.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
